mechanism: Fish oil (omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids) has antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that may potentiate tamoxifen's established prothrombotic effects, increasing bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; counsel patient on fish oil dosing (typical therapeutic dose ≤3g/day); consider baseline coagulation assessment if high-dose fish oil is used concurrently with tamoxifen.
